name: Complaint Handling Policy
description: Policy governing the handling, investigation, and resolution of customer service complaints. Establishes procedures for timeline review, staff interviews, and compensation determination based on fault and impact severity.

name: Service Complaint Investigation Requirement
description: Mandatory requirement to investigate service complaints through a structured process including timeline verification, procedure review, reasonableness assessment, and staff interviews where necessary.
consequence_of_breach: Complaint may not be properly resolved; customer may escalate to regulator

description: Obligation to provide apology and compensation when the bank is found at fault, with compensation levels scaled to the severity of inconvenience or distress caused to the customer.

name: Process Improvement Following Complaint Resolution
description: Requirement to implement process improvements and preventive measures following complaint resolution to prevent recurrence of identified service failures.

consequence_of_breach: repeated complaints; failure to demonstrate learning
required_action: implement process improvement to prevent recurrence

name: Service Failure Risk
description: Operational risk category encompassing service delivery failures such as long wait times, provision of incorrect information, and poor staff conduct that may result in customer complaints and reputational damage.
context: Example: Long wait, incorrect information, rude staff
risk_definition: Failure to deliver service to expected standard, including delays, inaccuracy, or poor staff conduct
required_response: formal investigation, fault determination, compensation if warranted, process improvement

name: Complaint Investigation Officer
description: Role responsible for conducting structured investigations into service complaints, including timeline verification, procedure review, reasonableness assessment, and staff interviews.
accountability_for: thorough and impartial investigation of service complaints

name: Complaint Resolution Authority
description: Role responsible for determining fault, authorizing compensation, and ensuring process improvements are implemented following complaint resolution.
context: If at fault: Apology + compensation for inconvenience
Compensation: Up to £100 for minor inconvenience, more if significant distress/loss
Learning: Process improvement to prevent recurrence
specific_obligations: determine fault based on investigation findings
authority: determine fault; authorize compensation up to £100 for minor inconvenience; approve additional compensation for significant distress or loss
accountability_for: fair and timely complaint resolution; implementation of corrective actions

name: Complaint Timeline Review
description: Control measure requiring verification and review of complaint timelines to establish the sequence of events and identify service failure points.
evidence_required: timeline documentation showing when service was requested, delivered, and any delays

name: Procedure Compliance Audit
description: Control measure requiring review of procedures followed during the service interaction to determine whether established protocols were correctly executed.
evidence_required: procedure documentation; records of steps followed; assessment of reasonableness

name: Staff Interview Process
description: Control measure enabling investigation teams to conduct interviews with staff members involved in the complaint incident to gather firsthand accounts and clarify procedural adherence.
evidence_required: interview notes; staff statements; contemporaneous records

name: Fee Disputes Policy
description: Policy governing the investigation and resolution of customer complaints regarding unexpected charges, overdraft fees, and card replacement fees. Establishes investigation procedures including review of terms and conditions, fee application accuracy, and disclosure clarity, with resolution pathways based on investigation findings.
context: Unexpected charge, overdraft fee, card replacement fee
If fee applied correctly per T&Cs: Explain and decline reversal
scope_summary: Addresses investigation and resolution of customer disputes regarding unexpected charges, overdraft fees, and card replacement fees
core_policy_statement: Fee disputes must be investigated by reviewing terms and conditions, fee application accuracy, and disclosure clarity, with resolution determined by the root cause

name: Fee Dispute Investigation Requirement
description: Mandatory requirement to investigate fee disputes by reviewing terms and conditions, verifying correct fee application, assessing clarity of fee disclosure, and reviewing customer account history.
consequence_of_breach: Disputes may be resolved incorrectly or customer dissatisfaction may escalate
verification_method: Review of terms and conditions, fee application records, and customer history

name: Fee Dispute Resolution - Correct Application
description: When investigation confirms fee was applied correctly per terms and conditions, the bank must explain the fee to the customer and decline reversal.
context: If fee applied correctly per T&Cs: Explain and decline reversal
applies_to: disputes where fee was applied correctly per terms and conditions
consequence_of_breach: Improper reversal of legitimate fees
verification_method: Confirmation that fee applied correctly and was disclosed in T&Cs

name: Fee Dispute Resolution - Error Correction
description: When investigation identifies a fee application error, the bank must reverse the charge and provide interest compensation to the customer.
context: If fee error: Reverse charge + interest
applies_to: disputes where fee was applied in error
consequence_of_breach: Customer financial loss and reputational damage
verification_method: Identification of fee application error in records

name: Fee Dispute Resolution - Unclear Terms
description: When investigation determines that terms and conditions were unclear regarding fee disclosure, the bank must refund the charge and provide an apology to the customer.
applies_to: disputes where terms and conditions were unclear
consequence_of_breach: Customer dissatisfaction and potential regulatory complaint
verification_method: Assessment of T&Cs clarity and disclosure adequacy

name: Unexpected Charge
description: Risk category covering customer complaints regarding charges that were not anticipated or clearly disclosed, requiring investigation and potential remediation.
context: Unexpected charge, overdraft fee, card replacement fee
risk_definition: A fee charged to a customer that was not anticipated or clearly communicated
examples: Charges not mentioned in terms and conditions
required_response: Investigate whether charge was applied correctly and disclosed clearly; resolve based on findings

name: Overdraft Fee
description: Risk category covering disputes related to overdraft fees charged to customer accounts, requiring investigation of application accuracy and disclosure clarity.
context: Unexpected charge, overdraft fee, card replacement fee
risk_definition: Fees charged when a customer's account balance falls below zero
examples: Overdraft charges applied to accounts that exceeded agreed limits
required_response: Verify fee was applied correctly per terms and conditions; reverse if error or terms were unclear

name: Card Replacement Fee
description: Risk category covering disputes related to fees charged for card replacement services, requiring investigation of correct application and disclosure.
context: Unexpected charge, overdraft fee, card replacement fee
risk_definition: Fees charged for replacing a damaged, lost, or expired card
examples: Card replacement charges disputed by customers
required_response: Confirm fee was disclosed and applied correctly; reverse if error or terms were unclear

name: Terms and Conditions Review
description: Control measure requiring review of applicable terms and conditions during fee dispute investigation to verify fee application accuracy and disclosure requirements.
context: Check if fee applied correctly per T&Cs
evidence_required: copy of applicable terms and conditions

name: Customer History Review
description: Control measure requiring review of customer account history as part of fee dispute investigation to assess patterns and context of disputed charges.

name: Fee Disclosure Assessment
description: Control measure requiring assessment of whether fees were disclosed clearly to the customer, used to determine appropriate resolution pathway.

name: Account Balance Discrepancy
description: A risk category covering situations where customer account balances are incorrect, credits are missing, or interest calculations are wrong. This includes discrepancies arising from bank errors, customer misunderstanding, or system failures.
context: Missing credit, wrong balance shown, interest miscalculated
If bank error: Correct balance + interest on missing amount
If system error: Urgent IT escalation to fix
risk_definition: Missing credit, wrong balance shown, or interest miscalculated in customer accounts
detection_mechanism: Transaction reconciliation, system records review, calculation verification, hold period review
required_response: Investigate root cause and apply appropriate resolution based on whether error is bank-caused, customer misunderstanding, or system malfunction

name: Transaction Reconciliation Requirement
description: A mandatory requirement to reconcile all transactions on an account when investigating balance discrepancies. This is part of the investigation process to identify the root cause of balance issues.
context: Investigation: Reconcile transactions, Check system records, Verify calculations

name: System Records Verification
description: A mandatory requirement to check and verify system records when investigating account balance issues. This ensures that recorded transactions match actual system data.
context: Investigation: Reconcile transactions, Check system records, Verify calculations

name: Calculation Verification
description: A mandatory requirement to verify all calculations, particularly interest calculations, when investigating account balance discrepancies.
context: Investigation: Reconcile transactions, Check system records, Verify calculations

name: Hold Period Review
description: A mandatory requirement to review any hold periods on funds when investigating account balance issues, as holds may explain apparent missing credits.
context: Investigation: Reconcile transactions, Check system records, Verify calculations, Review any hold periods
verification_method: Review any hold periods affecting account balance

name: Bank Error Balance Correction
description: An obligation to correct the account balance and pay interest on any missing amount when the investigation determines that a bank error caused the discrepancy.
context: If bank error: Correct balance + interest on missing amount
applies_to: Resolution when bank error is identified
consequence_of_breach: Customer entitled to corrected balance plus interest on missing amount
required_action: Correct balance and apply interest on missing amount

name: Customer Education on Balance Issues
description: An obligation to educate and explain balance discrepancies to customers when the issue results from customer misunderstanding, without imposing penalties.
context: If customer misunderstanding: Explain (educate, don't penalize)
applies_to: Resolution when customer misunderstanding is identified
required_action: Explain balance issue to customer through education
consequence_of_breach: Do not penalize customer for misunderstanding

name: System Error IT Escalation
description: An obligation to escalate system errors urgently to the IT department for immediate remediation when a system error is identified as the cause of a balance discrepancy.
context: If system error: Urgent IT escalation to fix
applies_to: Resolution when system error is identified
required_action: Urgent IT escalation to fix system error

name: Transaction Reconciliation Process
description: A control measure requiring reconciliation of transactions to identify discrepancies and verify account accuracy during balance issue investigations.
context: Investigation: Reconcile transactions, Check system records, Verify calculations

name: System Records Audit
description: A control measure requiring verification of system records to ensure that recorded transactions and balances are accurate and complete.
context: Investigation: Reconcile transactions, Check system records, Verify calculations
evidence_required: System audit logs and records verification documentation

name: Calculation Verification Control
description: A control measure requiring verification of all calculations, particularly interest calculations, to ensure mathematical accuracy in account balances.
context: Investigation: Reconcile transactions, Check system records, Verify calculations
applies_to: Account balance and interest calculation accuracy

name: Unauthorized Transaction
description: A financial transaction on a customer account that the customer claims was not authorized by them. The policy requires investigation to determine whether fraud occurred, customer liability applies, or the transaction remains disputed.
risk_definition: Transaction initiated without customer authorization or consent
required_response: Escalate to Fraud Team if needed

name: Fraudulent Transaction Investigation
description: The investigation process triggered when a customer reports a potentially fraudulent transaction. The investigation includes obtaining statements, reviewing transaction details, checking authorization status, and assessing fraud likelihood, with escalation to the fraud team if needed.
investigation_or_escalation_path: Escalate to Fraud Team if needed
reimbursement_obligation: Full reimbursement within 10 business days if fraud confirmed

name: Fraudulent Transaction Reimbursement Within 10 Business Days
canonical_name: Fraudulent Transaction Reimbursement Within 10 Business Days

description: When fraud is confirmed on a customer account, the bank must provide full reimbursement to the customer within 10 business days and issue an apology.
context: If fraud confirmed: Full reimbursement within 10 business days + apology
consequence_of_breach: Regulatory non-compliance; customer dissatisfaction; potential FCA enforcement

name: Customer Liability Explanation for Unauthorized Transactions
canonical_name: Customer Liability Explanation for Unauthorized Transactions
description: When investigation determines the customer is liable for an unauthorized transaction, the bank must provide an explanation to the customer in an educational manner.
applies_to: Transactions where customer is determined liable
consequence_of_breach: Failure to educate customer; potential complaint escalation
verification_method: Documentation of explanation provided to customer

name: Disputed Transaction Further Investigation and FCA Guidance
canonical_name: Disputed Transaction Further Investigation and FCA Guidance

context: If disputed: Further investigation + FCA guidance

consequence_of_breach: Non-compliance with FCA guidance; unresolved customer disputes
verification_method: Further investigation documentation; FCA guidance application records

name: Fraud Policy
description: The bank's formal policy governing fraud detection, investigation, and resolution procedures for unauthorized transactions and customer fraud claims.
core_policy_statement: Bank investigates unauthorized and fraudulent transactions; reimburses confirmed fraud within 10 business days; explains customer liability; escalates disputed cases per FCA guidance
scope_summary: Covers investigation, resolution, and reimbursement of fraudulent and unauthorized transactions

name: Customer
description: A natural person who holds a bank account and may report fraudulent or unauthorized transactions for investigation and resolution.

name: Fraud Team
description: The operational team responsible for investigating fraud alerts and unauthorized transaction claims when escalation from initial review is required.
specific_obligations: Investigate fraudulent transaction claims when escalated

name: Disputed Transaction
description: A financial transaction on a customer account that remains unresolved after investigation, requiring further inquiry and application of FCA guidance.
context: If disputed: Further investigation + FCA guidance
monitoring_or_reporting_obligation: Escalate to Fraud Team if needed

name: Account Takeover
description: A fraud scenario where a customer's account is used without authorization, typically involving compromise of authentication credentials or identity theft. The policy defines investigation and resolution procedures including immediate account freeze, transaction review, and customer reimbursement.
context: Customer discovers account used without permission
risk_definition: Customer account used without permission by unauthorized party
examples: Customer discovers account used without permission

name: Account Takeover Investigation
description: The investigation process triggered when a customer reports unauthorized account access. The procedure includes immediate account freeze, transaction review, authentication review, fraud team escalation, and potential law enforcement notification.

name: Immediate Account Freeze
description: An emergency protective measure executed immediately upon discovery of unauthorized account access to prevent further fraudulent transactions and protect customer assets.

name: Transaction Review
description: A review of account transactions to identify and document fraudulent activity following an account takeover incident.
context: Investigation: Immediate account freeze, Transaction review

name: Authentication Review
description: An examination of customer authentication mechanisms, including password changes and access credentials, to determine how unauthorized access was gained and to prevent recurrence.

name: Fraud Team
description: The team responsible for escalation and investigation of account takeover incidents, including coordination of investigation activities and law enforcement notification.

name: Law Enforcement Notification
description: The process of notifying law enforcement authorities when an account takeover incident warrants criminal investigation, performed as part of the fraud investigation procedure.

name: Fraudulent Transaction Reimbursement

context: Resolution: Full reimbursement of fraudulent transactions
generation_trigger: Account takeover investigation confirms unauthorized transactions

name: Account Security Reset
description: A remedial control measure that resets account security settings following an account takeover incident to restore customer protection.

name: Replacement Card

block_or_replacement_conditions: Account takeover or fraudulent card use

name: Online Access Reset
description: A reset of online banking access credentials and settings performed as part of account takeover resolution to prevent further unauthorized access.

name: Credit Monitoring
description: A protective service offered to customers when account takeover involves identity theft, providing ongoing monitoring of credit activity to detect further fraudulent use of personal information.
escalation_path: Fraud team if suspicious activity detected

name: Regular Follow-up
description: Ongoing contact and support provided to customers following account takeover resolution to ensure their concerns are addressed and no further unauthorized activity occurs.
evidence_required: Follow-up contact records and customer confirmation

name: Customer
description: The individual customer who discovers and reports unauthorized account access, and who is the subject of investigation and resolution procedures including reimbursement and account security restoration.
context: Customer discovers account used without permission
eligibility_or_verification_status: Entitled to full reimbursement and account recovery services

name: Complaint Escalation Policy
description: A policy governing the escalation of customer complaints through defined authority levels based on severity, financial impact, and involvement triggers. scope_summary: Applies to all customer complaints requiring resolution; escalation triggered by unresolved status, compensation threshold, regulatory concern, media/legal involvement, or FCA escalation

authority: director-level complaint review and escalation decision

specific_obligations: handle major complaint failures with reputational risk

name: Regulatory Compliance Risk

name: Compensation Approval Authority for Amounts £100 to £500

name: Conduct Risk

risk_definition: Risk arising from complaints alleging breaches of conduct standards or improper conduct by the firm or its staff

name: Systemic Compliance Risk

risk_definition: Risk arising from systemic issues that indicate widespread or recurring compliance failures affecting multiple customers or processes
examples: repeated breaches of the same rule

name: Complaints Policy
description: A policy governing the tracking, recording, and management of customer complaints. The policy mandates capture of complaint metadata including date, type, category, customer details, resolution outcome, compensation, and resolution timeframe to ensure systematic complaint handling and regulatory compliance.
scope_summary: Tracking and documentation of customer complaints including date, type, category, customer details, outcome, compensation, and resolution time
core_policy_statement: Systematic capture and tracking of complaint data to monitor trends and ensure consistent handling

name: Complaint Date Recording
description: A mandatory requirement to record and track the date on which each complaint is received. This provision ensures temporal accountability and enables monitoring of complaint resolution timelines.
evidence_required: complaint date recorded in tracking system

name: Complaint Type and Category Classification
description: A mandatory requirement to classify and record the type and category of each complaint received. This provision enables systematic categorisation and trend analysis of complaint patterns.

name: Customer Details Recording
description: A mandatory requirement to capture and retain customer details associated with each complaint. This provision ensures proper identification and linkage of complaints to customer accounts.
evidence_required: customer details captured and retained with complaint record

name: Complaint Outcome Documentation
description: A mandatory requirement to record the outcome of each complaint investigation, categorised as upheld, rejected, or partial. This provision ensures transparent documentation of complaint resolution decisions.
evidence_required: outcome recorded as upheld, rejected, or partial

name: Compensation Payment Recording
description: A mandatory requirement to record and track compensation paid to customers as a result of complaint resolution. This provision ensures financial accountability and audit trail for complaint-related payments.
evidence_required: compensation amount and payment details documented

name: Time to Resolution Tracking
description: A mandatory requirement to measure and record the time taken to resolve each complaint from receipt to final outcome. This provision enables monitoring of complaint handling efficiency and regulatory compliance with resolution timeframes.
evidence_required: resolution timeframe recorded for trend analysis

name: Complaint Handling Risk
description: The risk that complaints are not properly tracked, categorised, or resolved in accordance with regulatory requirements. This includes risks of inadequate record-keeping, delayed resolution, and failure to identify systemic issues through complaint trend analysis.
risk_definition: Inadequate tracking, documentation, or resolution of customer complaints leading to regulatory non-compliance and customer dissatisfaction
detection_mechanism: Systematic review of complaint data and resolution metrics
required_response: Ensure complete documentation of all complaint elements and timely resolution

name: Complaints Handling and Reporting Policy
description: A policy governing the reporting and analytics of customer complaints to internal management, the Board, and the Financial Conduct Authority. The policy establishes mandatory reporting cadences and content requirements at monthly, quarterly, and annual intervals, with specific metrics and trend analysis obligations.
scope_summary: Covers complaints reporting at monthly, quarterly, and annual intervals to internal management, board, and external regulator

name: Monthly Complaints Report to Management
description: Mandatory monthly reporting obligation requiring submission of complaints data to management, including total complaints received, average resolution time, upheld versus rejected ratio, financial compensation paid, and identified trends and patterns.

name: Quarterly Complaints Report to Board
description: Mandatory quarterly reporting obligation requiring submission of complaints analysis to the Board, including complaint volume trends, top complaint types, systemic issues identified, and corrective actions taken.

name: Annual Complaints Report to FCA
description: Mandatory annual reporting obligation to the Financial Conduct Authority requiring submission of aggregate complaints statistics, complaint handling effectiveness metrics, and documentation of process improvements implemented.

name: Financial Conduct Authority
description: The UK financial regulator to which the bank must submit annual aggregate complaints statistics and complaint handling effectiveness reports as mandated by this policy.

name: Board
description: The Board receives quarterly reports on complaint volume trends, top complaint types, systemic issues, and corrective actions taken, establishing accountability for complaints management at the governance level.

name: Management
description: Management receives monthly complaints reports detailing total complaints, resolution times, upheld versus rejected ratios, compensation paid, and identified trends and patterns for operational oversight.

name: Complaints Learning and Improvement Policy
description: A policy framework requiring the bank to identify systemic complaint patterns, analyze root causes, implement corrective actions, and monitor their effectiveness. The policy mandates a structured approach to complaints management that goes beyond individual resolution to drive organizational improvement.
context: Identify systemic complaints (same issue, multiple customers)
core_policy_statement: Identify systemic complaints, analyze root causes, implement corrective actions, and monitor their effectiveness
scope_summary: Applies to complaint patterns affecting multiple customers; focuses on systemic issues rather than isolated incidents

name: Systemic Complaint Identification Requirement
description: Banks must identify complaints that represent systemic issues — the same problem affecting multiple customers — rather than treating each complaint in isolation. This provision requires pattern recognition across the complaint population.
context: Identify systemic complaints (same issue, multiple customers)
core_requirement: Identify complaints that represent systemic issues (same issue affecting multiple customers)

name: Root Cause Analysis Obligation
description: Once systemic complaints are identified, the bank must conduct a root cause analysis to understand the underlying reason for the complaint pattern, not merely the surface symptom.
core_requirement: Analyze the root cause of identified systemic complaints

name: Corrective Action Implementation Requirement
description: The bank must implement corrective actions in response to identified root causes. This provision mandates that analysis must be followed by concrete remedial steps to address systemic issues.
core_requirement: Implement corrective actions in response to root cause analysis findings

name: Corrective Action Effectiveness Monitoring
description: The bank must monitor the effectiveness of corrective actions implemented in response to systemic complaints. This provision requires ongoing evaluation to ensure that remedial measures actually resolve the underlying issue.
core_requirement: Monitor the effectiveness of implemented corrective actions

name: Slow Processing
description: A complaint category identified in the policy as an example of a systemic issue that may arise from inadequate Standard Operating Procedures or insufficient resource allocation. The policy illustrates that slow processing complaints should trigger SOP review and resource augmentation.
context: High 'slow processing' complaints → Review SOP, add resources
risk_definition: Complaints indicating delays in transaction or service processing
examples: High volume of slow processing complaints
required_response: Review standard operating procedures and add resources

name: Fee Dispute
description: A complaint category identified as a systemic issue that may result from unclear Terms and Conditions or inadequate fee disclosure. The policy indicates that multiple fee disputes should trigger improved T&C clarity and better customer disclosure.
context: Multiple fee disputes → Improve T&C clarity, better disclosure
risk_definition: Complaints related to fees charged to customers
examples: Multiple fee disputes from different customers
required_response: Improve terms and conditions clarity and enhance fee disclosure

name: Fraud
description: A complaint category identified as a systemic issue that may indicate weaknesses in security measures. The policy illustrates that fraud complaints should trigger strengthened security controls.
risk_definition: Complaints related to fraudulent activity or security breaches

name: Standard Operating Procedure Review
description: A control measure requiring review of Standard Operating Procedures when systemic complaints (such as slow processing) are identified. This measure ensures that operational processes are evaluated and improved in response to complaint patterns.
context: High 'slow processing' complaints → Review SOP, add resources
trigger: Identification of systemic slow processing complaints

name: Resource Allocation Adjustment
description: A control measure requiring the bank to add resources when systemic complaints indicate resource constraints. This measure addresses operational bottlenecks identified through complaint analysis.
context: High 'slow processing' complaints → Review SOP, add resources
trigger: Root cause analysis indicating resource insufficiency

name: Terms and Conditions Clarity Enhancement
description: A control measure requiring improvement to Terms and Conditions clarity when systemic fee disputes are identified. This measure ensures that customer-facing documentation is enhanced to reduce misunderstandings.
context: Multiple fee disputes → Improve T&C clarity, better disclosure

name: Fee Disclosure Enhancement
description: A control measure requiring better disclosure of fees to customers when systemic fee disputes are identified. This measure improves transparency and reduces complaint recurrence.
context: Multiple fee disputes → Improve T&C clarity, better disclosure
trigger: Root cause analysis of fee dispute complaints

name: Security Measures Strengthening
description: A control measure requiring the bank to strengthen security measures when systemic fraud complaints are identified. This measure addresses security vulnerabilities revealed through complaint patterns.

name: All Staff
description: All bank staff members are assigned collective responsibilities for complaint handling, including taking complaints seriously, recording them accurately and promptly, escalating appropriately, following procedures, maintaining confidentiality, and treating customers respectfully.
specific_obligation: Treat customers respectfully during complaints handling

name: Complaints Handling Policy
description: A policy governing the handling of customer complaints by all staff, establishing standards for complaint receipt, recording, escalation, and customer treatment.
core_policy_statement: All staff must take complaints seriously, record them accurately and promptly, escalate appropriately, follow procedures, maintain confidentiality, and treat customers respectfully

name: Mandatory Complaint Recording
description: Staff must record all complaints accurately and promptly upon receipt, ensuring complete documentation of customer grievances.

name: Complaint Escalation Requirement
description: Staff must escalate complaints appropriately according to established procedures, ensuring complaints reach the correct authority or department for resolution.

name: Complaint Confidentiality Obligation
description: Staff must maintain confidentiality regarding all complaint information and customer details disclosed during the complaint process.

name: Respectful Customer Treatment in Complaints
description: Staff must treat customers respectfully throughout the complaint handling process, maintaining professional conduct and dignity.
requirement: Treat customers respectfully during complaints handling

name: Complaint Procedure Compliance
description: All staff must follow established complaint handling procedures in their interactions with customers and processing of complaints.

name: Serious Complaint Treatment
description: Staff must take all complaints seriously, ensuring no complaint is dismissed or deprioritised regardless of perceived severity.

name: Customer Service and Branch Staff
description: Staff members responsible for receiving customer complaints, providing immediate acknowledgment, logging complaints in the system, and escalating urgent issues to appropriate management.

name: Complaint Receipt and Acknowledgment
description: Customer service and branch staff are required to receive complaints from customers and provide immediate acknowledgment upon receipt.

name: Complaint Logging in System
description: All complaints received must be logged in the system to maintain a record and enable tracking of complaint handling.

name: Escalation of Urgent Issues
description: Customer service and branch staff must escalate urgent issues to appropriate management or designated personnel for priority handling.

name: Complaint Logging System
description: A system used by customer service and branch staff to record and track all complaints received from customers, enabling audit trail and escalation management.

name: Complaints Handler
description: Staff role responsible for investigating customer complaints, documenting findings, following resolution procedures, communicating with customers, meeting regulatory timeframes, and escalating complex cases as needed.

name: Thorough Complaint Investigation
description: Complaints handlers must conduct thorough investigations into all customer complaints received.

name: Complaint Findings Documentation
description: Complaints handlers must document all findings from complaint investigations.

name: Complaint Resolution Procedure Compliance
description: Complaints handlers must follow established resolution procedures when handling customer complaints.

name: Customer Communication on Complaints
description: Complaints handlers must communicate clearly with customers regarding their complaints and resolution status.
core_requirement: Communicate clearly with customers regarding their complaints

name: Complaint Resolution Timeframe Compliance
description: Complaints handlers must meet established regulatory and internal timeframes for complaint resolution.
core_requirement: Meet established timeframes for complaint resolution

name: Complaint Escalation
description: Complaints handlers must escalate complaints to appropriate management or specialist teams when necessary.

name: Management
description: Management holds accountability for complaints handling oversight, including approval of complaints exceeding £500, trend monitoring, implementation of corrective actions, Board reporting, and liaison with external regulators.

name: Complaints Approval Threshold
description: Management must approve all complaints with a value exceeding £500. This provision establishes a financial threshold for escalated approval authority.

name: Complaints Trend Monitoring
description: Management is required to monitor trends in complaints data to identify patterns and systemic issues in complaints handling.

name: Corrective Action Implementation
description: Management must implement corrective actions in response to identified complaints trends and issues.
specific_obligation: Implement corrective actions in response to complaints

name: Board Reporting on Complaints
description: Management is obligated to report complaints data, trends, and corrective actions to the Board.

name: External Regulatory Liaison
description: Management must maintain liaison with external regulatory authorities regarding complaints handling and related compliance matters.
specific_obligation: Maintain external regulatory liaison on complaints matters
